recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1980s fantasy illustration featuring a blonde female warrior riding a giant winged creature against a black void, accompanied by bold chrome-textured display typography and a list of names in a slanted sans-serif.
coreVisualRelationships: The central figure's sword points directly toward the primary title logo.
The pinkish-red highlights on the creature's wings echo the color of the secondary text.
The dark, billowing smoke clouds provide a silhouette for the bright character and mount.
coreInvariants: Diagonal text alignment for the list

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central character and mount occupy the right two-thirds of the frame, scaled to dominate the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing white starburst at the tip of the raised sword.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left logo, moves down the text list, follows the creature's wing back up to the warrior, and peaks at the sword tip.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space on the bottom and left sides to emphasize the vibrant subject and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan-to-magenta chrome gradients for the main title.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta/pink for secondary text and wing membranes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the character and text against a zero-value black background.

letterConstructionRules: Display type features a heavy 3D extrusion effect.
Letters are tightly kerned with overlapping edges.
Horizontal chrome reflection line bisects the glyphs.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the display title has a sharp, triangular peak.
The 'Y' has a deep, wide crotch.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, chrome-textured custom display face paired with a clean, slanted geometric sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky structure for the display text.
Matches the clean, slanted list style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: An airbrushed 80s fantasy illustration on a black background. A blonde warrior woman in leather armor rides a giant, prehistoric-looking bird-creature with pink wings. She holds a sword aloft with a bright white starburst at the tip. Dark purple smoke clouds billow behind them.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, two-line display title in the top left using a custom blocky font with a cyan-to-white chrome gradient and magenta base. Below it, add a list of names in a white, bold, slanted sans-serif font, aligned to a 15-degree diagonal.

verificationChecks: Does the display text have a chrome reflection effect?
Is the list of names slanted?
Is there a starburst flare on the sword tip?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the chrome effect has a distinct horizontal 'horizon' line.
Check that the text list does not overlap the main character.
Verify the starburst is the brightest point in the image.
Confirm the 3D extrusion on the title is consistent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast airbrushed fantasy subject with 80s chrome display type and slanted sans-serif metadata for a retro-cinematic look.
